name: E2E core 271: trace volume and where the trend is
situation: You are a LangWatch user talking to Langy, the in-product assistant. Write short, plain messages and never mention the test state. In your first message, write exactly: 'what's my trace volume this week and where can I see the trend?'. Once Langy has answered, reply 'Thanks.'
criteria: Langy returns a concrete number or summary statistic.
Langy shows the trend where the user can see it (a chart card in the reply) or names the section it lives in, rather than writing out a web address.
Langy doesn't ask the user to clarify timeframe.
